description: This file defines a shared informer for the ClusterTrustBundle resource in Kubernetes, including functions to create and manage informers with various options, and interfaces for accessing the informer and lister.

classes.name: clusterTrustBundleInformer
classes.description: Implementation of the ClusterTrustBundleInformer interface, managing shared informer factory and list options.

methods.name: NewClusterTrustBundleInformer
methods.description: Creates a new shared informer for ClusterTrustBundle with default options.

methods.name: NewFilteredClusterTrustBundleInformer
methods.description: Creates a new shared informer for ClusterTrustBundle with custom list options.

methods.name: NewClusterTrustBundleInformerWithOptions
methods.description: Creates a new shared informer for ClusterTrustBundle with detailed options including resync period, indexers, and tweak functions.

methods.name: defaultInformer
methods.description: Returns the default shared index informer with namespace indexing.

methods.name: Informer
methods.description: Returns the shared index informer for ClusterTrustBundle.

methods.name: Lister
methods.description: Returns the lister for ClusterTrustBundle resources.
